name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Levinbolt) — 2 Intermediate — Zeus' Fury

system.description: You can hurl bolts of electrical energy as well as deliver them by touch, up to three total, one per turn, each dealing three levels of lethal damage and stunning the target. You direct thrown bolts by pitting your Mental Traits against the target's Physical Traits (metal armor grants no protection), using Science for retests. The charge lasts for a number of turns equal to your permanent Willpower Traits, or until spent.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
